## Calculate pi and dxy in windows 
```{r}
## Read centromeres 
centromeres <- read.csv2('/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/01_data/tair10/centr_boundaries_wlodzimierz2023.txt',header=T, sep="\t")
centromeres$start <- as.numeric(centromeres$start)
centromeres$stop <-as.numeric(centromeres$stop)
centromeres <- centromeres %>% mutate(chromosome = paste0("Chr", chrom))
## Add peri-centromeres defined based on the heterochtomatin 
peri.centromeres <- read.csv2('/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/001_chromatin_states/chromatin_states_in_windows_500kb_250kb_sliding.csv',header=T, sep=";")

## Function to calculate windows 
calc_window <- function(data, window_size = 500000, step_size = 250000) {
  chromosomes <- unique(data$chromosome)
  results <- list()
  for (chr in chromosomes) {
    chr_data <- data %>% filter(chromosome == chr)
    max_pos  <- max(chr_data$window_pos_2, na.rm = TRUE)
    starts <- seq(1, max_pos, by = step_size)
    for (ws in starts) {
      we <- ws + window_size - 1
      overlap <- chr_data %>% filter(window_pos_1 <= we & window_pos_2 >= ws)
      if (nrow(overlap) == 0) next
      results[[length(results) + 1]] <- overlap %>%
        mutate(window_start = ws, window_end = we)
    }
  }
  bind_rows(results)
}

# Calculate average pi/dxy
average_pi <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    group_by(chromosome, window_start, window_end) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      avg_pi_window = sum(count_diffs) / sum(count_comparisons),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}
```
## Apply pi/dxy calculation in sliding windows  
```{r}
pi_4fold_thal <- pi_4fold_thal %>% calc_window() %>% average_pi()
pi_4fold_thal <- pi_4fold_thal %>%
  dplyr::rename( avg_pi_window_thaliana=avg_pi_window)

pi4_fold_lyrata <- pi4_fold_lyrata %>% calc_window() %>% average_pi()
pi4_fold_lyrata <- pi4_fold_lyrata %>%
  dplyr::rename(avg_pi_window_lyrata=avg_pi_window)

pi4_fold_lyrata_thaliana_divergence <- pi4_fold_lyrata_thaliana_divergence %>% calc_window() %>% average_pi()
pi4_fold_lyrata_thaliana_divergence <- pi4_fold_lyrata_thaliana_divergence %>%
  dplyr::rename(avg_dxy = avg_pi_window)

## Combine dxy, pi in thaliana and pi il lyrata together 
combined_diversity_divergence <- pi_4fold_thal %>%
  inner_join(pi4_fold_lyrata, by = c("chromosome", "window_start", "window_end")) %>%
  inner_join(pi4_fold_lyrata_thaliana_divergence, by = c("chromosome", "window_start", "window_end"))

#write.csv2(combined_diversity_divergence, "/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/001_figure_with_all_estimates/diversity_divergence.csv", quote = F, row.names = F)
```
## Pi in thaliana & lyrata 
```{r}
# scaling factor to align the two y axes
scale_factor <- mean(combined_diversity_divergence$avg_pi_window_thaliana, na.rm = TRUE) /
                mean(combined_diversity_divergence$avg_pi_window_lyrata, na.rm = TRUE)


# mask centromere region for Chr1
div_all <- combined_diversity_divergence %>%
  #filter(chromosome == "Chr1") %>%
  left_join(centromeres %>% dplyr::select(chromosome, centr_start = start, centr_stop = stop),
            by = "chromosome") %>%
  mutate(
    avg_pi_window_thaliana = ifelse(window_start <= centr_stop  + 250000 &
                                    window_end   >= centr_start - 250000,
                                    NA, avg_pi_window_thaliana),
    avg_pi_window_lyrata   = ifelse(window_start <= centr_stop  + 250000 &
                                    window_end   >= centr_start - 250000,
                                    NA, avg_pi_window_lyrata),
    region = case_when(
      window_end   < centr_start - 250000 ~ "left",
      window_start > centr_stop  + 250000 ~ "right",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    med_thal  = median(avg_pi_window_thaliana, na.rm = TRUE),
    above_thal = ifelse(avg_pi_window_thaliana >= med_thal, avg_pi_window_thaliana, med_thal),
    med_lyr   = median(avg_pi_window_lyrata, na.rm = TRUE) * scale_factor,
    above_lyr  = ifelse(avg_pi_window_lyrata * scale_factor >= med_lyr,
                        avg_pi_window_lyrata * scale_factor, med_lyr)
  )

chr1_centromere <- centromeres %>% filter(chromosome == "Chr1")

p <- ggplot(div_all, aes(x = window_start / 1e6)) +
  geom_rect(data = centromeres,
            aes(xmin = (start - 250000) / 1e6, xmax = (stop + 250000) / 1e6,
                ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "darkgrey", alpha = 0.3) +
  # thaliana ribbon + points + smooth
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = med_thal, ymax = above_thal), fill = "#053061", alpha = 0.3, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = med_thal), linetype = "dashed", color = "#053061", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(y = avg_pi_window_thaliana), size = 0.8, color = "#053061", na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(data = div_all %>% filter(region == "left"),
              aes(y = avg_pi_window_thaliana),
              method = "loess", span = 0.2, color = "#053061", se = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(data = div_all %>% filter(region == "right"),
              aes(y = avg_pi_window_thaliana),
              method = "loess", span = 0.2, color = "#053061", se = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
  # lyrata ribbon + points + smooth
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = med_lyr, ymax = above_lyr), fill = "#d6604d", alpha = 0.3, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = med_lyr), linetype = "dashed", color = "#d6604d", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(y = avg_pi_window_lyrata * scale_factor), size = 0.8, color = "#d6604d", na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(data = div_all %>% filter(region == "left"),
              aes(y = avg_pi_window_lyrata * scale_factor),
              method = "loess", span = 0.2, color = "#d6604d", se = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(data = div_all %>% filter(region == "right"),
              aes(y = avg_pi_window_lyrata * scale_factor),
              method = "loess", span = 0.2, color = "#d6604d", se = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = expression(pi ~ "thaliana"),
    labels = function(x) format(x, scientific = FALSE),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / scale_factor,
                        name = expression(pi ~ "lyrata"),
                        labels = function(x) format(x, scientific = FALSE))
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ chromosome, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = "Position (Mb)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y.left  = element_text(color = "#053061"),
    axis.text.y.left   = element_text(color = "#053061"),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "#d6604d"),
    axis.text.y.right  = element_text(color = "#d6604d")
  )

ggsave("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/figures/pi_thal_lyrata_all_chr.png",
       plot = p,
       width = 300, height = 100, units = "mm", dpi = 600,
       device = png, type = "cairo", bg = "white")
```
## Marking region of frigida gene 
```{r}
div_all <- combined_diversity_divergence %>%
  filter(chromosome %in% c("Chr4", "Chr5")) %>%
  left_join(centromeres %>% dplyr::select(chromosome, centr_start = start, centr_stop = stop),
            by = "chromosome") %>%
  mutate(
    avg_pi_window_thaliana = ifelse(
      window_start <= centr_stop  + 250000 &
      window_end   >= centr_start - 250000,
      NA, avg_pi_window_thaliana
    ),
    region = case_when(
      window_end   < centr_start - 250000 ~ "left",
      window_start > centr_stop  + 250000 ~ "right",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(chromosome) %>%
  mutate(
    med_thal   = median(avg_pi_window_thaliana, na.rm = TRUE),
    above_thal = ifelse(avg_pi_window_thaliana >= med_thal,
                        avg_pi_window_thaliana, med_thal)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# --- Reference data ---
chr_centromeres <- centromeres %>%
  filter(chromosome %in% c("Chr4", "Chr5"))

# Per-chromosome medians for geom_hline in facets
chr_medians <- div_all %>%
  distinct(chromosome, med_thal)

# Highlight regions (old = Chr5, new = Chr4)
highlight_regions <- data.frame(
  chromosome = c("Chr5", "Chr4"),
  xmin       = c((20764315 - 1000000) / 1e6, max(0, 269026  - 1000000) / 1e6),
  xmax       = c((20768681 + 1000000) / 1e6,     (271503   + 1000000) / 1e6),
  label      = c("Old neighborhood", "New neighborhood")
)

p <- ggplot(div_all, aes(x = window_start / 1e6)) +
  
  # Centromere shading
  geom_rect(data = chr_centromeres,
            aes(xmin = (start - 250000) / 1e6, xmax = (stop + 250000) / 1e6,
                ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "darkgrey", alpha = 0.3) +
  
  # Neighborhood highlight regions
  geom_rect(data = highlight_regions,
            aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.25) +

    name   = "Region",
    values = c("Old neighborhood" = "#78A083", "New neighborhood" = "#FF653F")
  ) +
  
  # Thaliana ribbon

              fill = "#7288AE", alpha = 0.3, na.rm = TRUE) +
  
  # Median dashed line (per chromosome)
  geom_hline(data = chr_medians,
             aes(yintercept = med_thal),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "#7288AE", linewidth = 0.5) +
  
  # Points
  geom_point(aes(y = avg_pi_window_thaliana),
             size = 0.8, color = "#7288AE", na.rm = TRUE) +
  
  # LOESS smooths — left and right of centromere separately
  geom_smooth(data = div_all %>% filter(region == "left"),

              method = "loess", span = 0.2,
              color = "#7288AE", se = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(data = div_all %>% filter(region == "right"),
              aes(y = avg_pi_window_thaliana),
              method = "loess", span = 0.2,
              color = "#7288AE", se = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ chromosome, scales = "free", ncol = 1) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    name   = expression(pi ~ "thaliana"),
    labels = function(x) format(x, scientific = FALSE)
  ) +
  labs(x = "Position (Mb)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    strip.background  = element_blank(),
    strip.text        = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y.left = element_text(color = "#7288AE"),
    axis.text.y.left  = element_text(color = "#7288AE"),
    legend.position   = "top"
  )

p
```

## Diversity VS divergence 
```{r}
# Calculate scale factor 
scale_factor <- mean(combined_diversity_divergence$avg_pi_window_thaliana, na.rm = TRUE) /
                mean(combined_diversity_divergence$avg_dxy, na.rm = TRUE)

div_all <- combined_diversity_divergence %>%
  left_join(centromeres %>% dplyr::select(chromosome, centr_start = start, centr_stop = stop),
            by = "chromosome") %>%
  mutate(
    avg_pi_window_thaliana = ifelse(window_start <= centr_stop  + 250000 &
                                    window_end   >= centr_start - 250000,
                                    NA, avg_pi_window_thaliana),
    avg_dxy                = ifelse(window_start <= centr_stop  + 250000 &
                                    window_end   >= centr_start - 250000,
                                    NA, avg_dxy),
    region = case_when(
      window_end   < centr_start - 250000 ~ "left",
      window_start > centr_stop  + 250000 ~ "right",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(chromosome) %>%                       # <- per-chromosome medians
  mutate(
    med_thal   = median(avg_pi_window_thaliana, na.rm = TRUE),
    above_thal = ifelse(avg_pi_window_thaliana >= med_thal, avg_pi_window_thaliana, med_thal),
    med_lyr    = median(avg_dxy, na.rm = TRUE) * scale_factor,
    above_lyr  = ifelse(avg_dxy * scale_factor >= med_lyr, avg_dxy * scale_factor, med_lyr)
  ) %>%
  ungroup

p <- ggplot(div_all, aes(x = window_start / 1e6)) +
  geom_rect(data = centromeres,                  # <- all centromeres
            aes(xmin = (start - 250000) / 1e6, xmax = (stop + 250000) / 1e6,
                ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "darkgrey", alpha = 0.3) +
  # thaliana ribbon + points + smooth
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = med_thal, ymax = above_thal), fill = "#053061", alpha = 0.3, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = med_thal), linetype = "dashed", color = "#053061", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(y = avg_pi_window_thaliana), size = 0.8, color = "#053061", na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(data = div_all %>% filter(region == "left"),
              aes(y = avg_pi_window_thaliana),
              method = "loess", span = 0.2, color = "#053061", se = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(data = div_all %>% filter(region == "right"),
              aes(y = avg_pi_window_thaliana),
              method = "loess", span = 0.2, color = "#053061", se = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
  # dxy ribbon + points + smooth
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = med_lyr, ymax = above_lyr), fill = "#d6604d", alpha = 0.3, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = med_lyr), linetype = "dashed", color = "#d6604d", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(y = avg_dxy * scale_factor), size = 0.8, color = "#d6604d", na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(data = div_all %>% filter(region == "left"),
              aes(y = avg_dxy * scale_factor),
              method = "loess", span = 0.2, color = "#d6604d", se = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(data = div_all %>% filter(region == "right"),
              aes(y = avg_dxy * scale_factor),
              method = "loess", span = 0.2, color = "#d6604d", se = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
```

## Add chromosome fusions(1-1 orthologous genes)
```{r}
pannagram_1_1_genes <- read.table("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/orthologous_genes/pannagram_simsearch/lyata_mn47_v2_thaliana_tair10_only_unique_thal_lyr.csv", header=T)
## Attach thaliana start and end
genes_athaliana <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/11_resources/ref_genome/TAIR10_GFF3_genes_transposons.gff")  %>% filter(V3=="gene")
genes_athaliana$gene_id <- sub(".*ID=([^;]+);.*", "\\1", genes_athaliana$V9)
genes_athaliana[, gene_id_clean := sub("Parent=([^.]+)\\..*", "\\1", gene_id)]
genes_athaliana <- genes_athaliana %>% dplyr::select(V1,V4,V5,gene_id_clean)
colnames(genes_athaliana) <- c("chr_thal", "star_thal", "end_thal", "gene_id_thal")
## Connect coordinates to genes 
pannagram_1_1_genes <- inner_join(pannagram_1_1_genes,genes_athaliana, by=c("thaliana_id"="gene_id_thal"))

pannagram_1_1_genes$lyrata_chr <- case_when(
  pannagram_1_1_genes$lyrata_chr == "CALYLY010000001.1" ~ "Chr1",
  pannagram_1_1_genes$lyrata_chr == "CALYLY010000112.1" ~ "Chr2",
  pannagram_1_1_genes$lyrata_chr == "CALYLY010000223.1" ~ "Chr3",
  pannagram_1_1_genes$lyrata_chr == "CALYLY010000334.1" ~ "Chr4",
  pannagram_1_1_genes$lyrata_chr == "CALYLY010000445.1" ~ "Chr5",
  pannagram_1_1_genes$lyrata_chr == "CALYLY010000556.1" ~ "Chr6",
  pannagram_1_1_genes$lyrata_chr == "CALYLY010000667.1" ~ "Chr7",
  pannagram_1_1_genes$lyrata_chr == "CALYLY010000762.1" ~ "Chr8",
  TRUE ~ pannagram_1_1_genes$lyrata_chr)

#write.csv2(pannagram_1_1_genes, "/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/001_figure_with_all_estimates/correspondance_thal_lyr_chromosomes.csv2", row.names = F, quote = F)
pannagram_1_1_genes <- pannagram_1_1_genes[pannagram_1_1_genes$chr_thal=="Chr1",]
pannagram_1_1_genes_chr1 <- pannagram_1_1_genes %>% dplyr::select(lyrata_chr,lyrata_start,lyrata_end,chr_thal,star_thal,end_thal)
```

## Scatterplots all chromosomes together, colored by proximity to centromere
```{r}
# Prepare tables
div_all <- combined_diversity_divergence %>%
  left_join(centromeres %>% dplyr::select(chromosome, centr_start = start, centr_stop = stop),
            by = "chromosome") %>%
  mutate(
    avg_pi_window_thaliana = ifelse(window_start <= centr_stop  + 250000 &
                                    window_end   >= centr_start - 250000,
                                    NA, avg_pi_window_thaliana),
    avg_pi_window_lyrata   = ifelse(window_start <= centr_stop  + 250000 &
                                    window_end   >= centr_start - 250000,
                                    NA, avg_pi_window_lyrata),
    region = case_when(
      window_end   < centr_start - 250000 ~ "left",
      window_start > centr_stop  + 250000 ~ "right",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    centr_mid = (centr_start + centr_stop) / 2,
    dist_to_centromere = abs((window_start + window_end) / 2 - centr_mid) / 1e6
  )

```

```{r}
library(patchwork)

# correlation labels
cor1 <- cor(div_all$avg_pi_window_thaliana, div_all$avg_pi_window_lyrata, use = "complete.obs")
cor2 <- cor(div_all$avg_pi_window_thaliana, div_all$avg_dxy,              use = "complete.obs")
cor3 <- cor(div_all$avg_pi_window_lyrata,   div_all$avg_dxy,              use = "complete.obs")

p1 <- ggplot(div_all, aes(avg_pi_window_thaliana, avg_pi_window_lyrata, color = dist_to_centromere)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6, na.rm = TRUE) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5,
           label = paste0("r = ", round(cor1, 2)), size = 5) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "#67001f", high = "#d1e5f0", name = "Distance to\ncentromere (Mb)") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) format(x, scientific = FALSE)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) format(x, scientific = FALSE)) +
  labs(x = expression(pi[thaliana]), y = expression(pi[lyrata])) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank())

p2 <- ggplot(div_all, aes(avg_pi_window_thaliana, avg_dxy, color = dist_to_centromere)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6, na.rm = TRUE) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5,
           label = paste0("r = ", round(cor2, 2)), size = 5) +
```

## Scatterplot with slope 
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
get_stats <- function(data, x, y) {
  d <- data[, c(x, y)]
  d <- d[complete.cases(d), ]  # same rows used for cor + lm
  fit <- lm(reformulate(x, y), data = d)

  list(
    r = cor(d[[x]], d[[y]]),
    slope = unname(coef(fit)[2]),
    intercept = unname(coef(fit)[1])
  )
}
div_all <- div_all[div_all$avg_dxy>0.04,]
```

## Diversity plot with peri-centromeres highlighting 
```{r}
div_all <- combined_diversity_divergence %>%
  left_join(centromeres %>% dplyr::select(chromosome, centr_start = start, centr_stop = stop),
            by = "chromosome") %>%
  mutate(
    avg_pi_window_thaliana = ifelse(window_start <= centr_stop  + 250000 &
                                    window_end   >= centr_start - 250000,
                                    NA, avg_pi_window_thaliana),
    region = case_when(
      window_end   < centr_start - 250000 ~ "left",
      window_start > centr_stop  + 250000 ~ "right",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    med_thal   = median(avg_pi_window_thaliana, na.rm = TRUE),
    above_thal = ifelse(avg_pi_window_thaliana >= med_thal, avg_pi_window_thaliana, med_thal)
  )


p <- ggplot(div_all, aes(x = window_start / 1e6)) +
  # pericentromere highlight
  geom_rect(data = peri_centromeres,
            aes(xmin = start / 1e6, xmax = end / 1e6, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "#D55E00", alpha = 0.15) +
  # centromere highlight
  geom_rect(data = centromeres,
            aes(xmin = (start - 250000) / 1e6, xmax = (stop + 250000) / 1e6,
                ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "darkgrey", alpha = 0.3) +
  # thaliana ribbon + points + smooth
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = med_thal, ymax = above_thal), fill = "#7288AE", alpha = 0.3, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = med_thal), linetype = "dashed", color = "#7288AE", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(y = avg_pi_window_thaliana), size = 0.8, color = "#7288AE", na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(data = div_all %>% filter(region == "left"),
              aes(y = avg_pi_window_thaliana),
              method = "loess", span = 0.2, color = "#7288AE", se = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_smooth(data = div_all %>% filter(region == "right"),
              aes(y = avg_pi_window_thaliana),
              method = "loess", span = 0.2, color = "#7288AE", se = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = expression(pi[thaliana]),
    labels = function(x) format(x, scientific = FALSE)
  ) +
  labs(x = "Position (Mb)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(color = "#7288AE"),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(color = "#7288AE")
  ) + facet_wrap(~chromosome, scales="free", nrow=5)

ggsave("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/figures/peri_centromeres_all_chr_chromatin_defined.png",
       plot = p,
       width = 300, height = 200, units = "mm", dpi = 600,
       device = png, type = "cairo", bg = "white")
```
## Make boxplots based on peri-centromeres and diversity
```{r}
div_regions <- combined_diversity_divergence %>%
  left_join(centromeres %>% dplyr::select(chromosome, centr_start = start, centr_stop = stop),
            by = "chromosome") %>%
  left_join(peri_centromeres %>% dplyr::select(chromosome, peri_start = start, peri_end = end),
            by = "chromosome") %>%
  filter(!(window_start <= centr_stop + 250000 & window_end >= centr_start - 250000)) %>%
  mutate(
    region = ifelse(window_start >= peri_start & window_end <= peri_end,
                    "Pericentromere", "Arm")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(chromosome, window_start, window_end, region,
         avg_pi_window_thaliana, avg_pi_window_lyrata, avg_dxy) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(avg_pi_window_thaliana, avg_pi_window_lyrata, avg_dxy),
               names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(metric = recode(metric,
                         "avg_pi_window_thaliana" = "pi[thaliana]",
                         "avg_pi_window_lyrata"   = "pi[lyrata]",
                         "avg_dxy"                = "d[XY]"))

div_regions <- div_regions %>%
  mutate(region = factor(region, levels = c("Pericentromere", "Arm")))


library(ggsignif)


wilcox_results <- div_regions %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    p = wilcox.test(value[region == "Pericentromere"],
                    value[region == "Arm"])$p.value,
    y_pos = max(value, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(label = case_when(
    p < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p < 0.01  ~ "**",
    p < 0.05  ~ "*",
    TRUE      ~ "ns"
  ))

p <- ggplot(div_regions %>% mutate(region = factor(region, levels = c("Pericentromere", "Arm"))),
       aes(x = region, y = value, fill = region)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.6, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.size = 0.5, fill = "white", alpha = 0.7, na.rm = TRUE) +
  #geom_text(data = wilcox_results, aes(x = 1.5, y = y_pos, label = label),
  #          inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 10) +
  #geom_segment(data = wilcox_results, aes(x = 1, xend = 2, y = y_pos * 0.99, yend = y_pos * 0.99),
   #            inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Arm" = "#d1e5f0", "Pericentromere" = "#67001f")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) format(x, scientific = FALSE)) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y", labeller = label_parsed) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Diversity") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 20) +
 theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 24),
      legend.position = "none")

ggsave("/groups/nordborg/projects/genome_organization/manuscript/04_output/figures/peri_centromeres_vs_arms_wo_wilxoc_test.png",
       plot = p,
       width = 300, height = 150, units = "mm", dpi = 600,
       device = png, type = "cairo", bg = "white")
```
